away.summary: The Flyers (5-10-6) are completing a five-game road trip and playing the first game of a weekend back-to-back. They earned a point in a 3-2 overtime loss to Edmonton on Wednesday, with Tyson Foerster and Travis Sanheim scoring. They are still searching for their first divisional win this season.

home.summary: The Blue Jackets (7-10-0) have lost three straight games in regulation, including a 3-1 home loss to Tampa Bay on Thursday. Coach Rick Bowness will miss a second straight game due to a health issue, with assistant Don Granato running the bench. Kent Johnson will replace Sean Monahan in the lineup.
